sub_parameters.name: ArchiveDays
sub_parameters.description: This parameter is required only when **RuleType** is set to **TRANSITION**. The number of days after which the backup is transitioned to archive storage. Unit: days.

sub_parameters.name: BackupType
sub_parameters.description: This parameter is required only when **RuleType** is set to **BACKUP**. The backup type. Set the value to **COMPLETE**, which indicates full backup.

sub_parameters.name: ColdArchiveDays
sub_parameters.description: This parameter is required only when **RuleType** is set to **TRANSITION**. The number of days after which the backup is transitioned to cold archive storage. Unit: days.

sub_parameters.name: DataSourceFilters
sub_parameters.description: This parameter is required only when **RuleType** is set to **TAG**. The data source filter rules.

sub_parameters.name: Immutable
sub_parameters.description: This parameter is valid only when **PolicyType** is set to **UDM_ECS_ONLY**. Specifies whether to enable backup locking.

sub_parameters.name: KeepLatestSnapshots
sub_parameters.description:
Specifies whether to retain at least one backup version. Valid values:
- 0: do not retain.
- 1: retain.

sub_parameters.name: ReplicationRegionId
sub_parameters.description: This parameter is required only when **RuleType** is set to **REPLICATION**. The ID of the destination region for replication.

sub_parameters.name: Retention
sub_parameters.description:
This parameter is required only when **RuleType** is set to **TRANSITION** or **REPLICATION**.
- If **RuleType** is set to **TRANSITION**: the retention period of the backup. Minimum value: 1. Unit: days.
- If **RuleType** is set to **REPLICATION**: the retention period of the cross-region backup. Minimum value: 1. Unit: days.

sub_parameters.name: RetentionRules
sub_parameters.description: This parameter is required only when **RuleType** is set to **TRANSITION**. The special retention rules.

sub_parameters.name: RuleType
sub_parameters.description:
The rule type. Each policy must have at least one **BACKUP** rule and exactly one **TRANSITION** rule. Valid values:
- **BACKUP**: backup rule.
- **TRANSITION**: lifecycle rule.
- **REPLICATION**: replication rule.

sub_parameters.name: Schedule
sub_parameters.description:
This parameter is required only when **RuleType** is set to **BACKUP**. The backup schedule settings. Supported formats:
- `I|{startTime}|{interval}`: specifies that a backup job is run at the {interval} from {startTime}. For example, `I|1631685600|P1D` specifies that a backup job is run once a day starting from 2021-09-15 14:00:00.

  * startTime: the start time of the backup. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
  * interval: the ISO 8601 time interval. For example, `PT1H` specifies an interval of one hour. `P1D` specifies an interval of one day.
- `C|{startTime}|{crontab}`: specifies that a backup job is run based on the {crontab} expression from {startTime}. For example, `C|1631685600|0 0 2 ? * 3,5,7` specifies that a backup job is run at 02:00:00 every Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday starting from 2021-09-15 14:00:00.
  * startTime: the start time of the backup. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
  * crontab: the crontab expression. For example, `0 0 2 ? * 3,5,7` specifies every Tuesday, Thursday, and Saturday at 02:00:00.

Backup jobs that are scheduled for past times are not compensated. If the previous backup job is not completed, the next backup job is not triggered.

sub_parameters.name: TagFilters
sub_parameters.description: This parameter is required only when **RuleType** is set to **TAG**. The resource tag filter rules.

sub_parameters.name: VaultId
sub_parameters.description: This parameter is required only when RuleType is set to BACKUP. The backup vault ID.
